purpose: Models may emit malformed JSON, provider failed-generation text, or protocol-specific markup instead of structured calls. This module recognizes only call-shaped text, repairs safe syntax defects, rejects ambiguous truncation and mixed invalid batches, and returns the message shapes consumed by the agent loop.
